title: TNT eggs!
description: TNT that summons on eggs being thrown.
body:
Have you ever wanted exploding eggs in your Minecraft world? Well then, this datapack is for you!
In "TNT eggs!" once you throw an egg in your world a line of TNT will summon then... EXPLODE!
[buy me a Hydrating Liquid!](https://buymeacoffee.com/mrmamey)
